_status: DRAFT FOR COUNSEL. NOT LOADED BY THE APP (app.py reads config/consent.json only). Facts, not legal advice. Written 2026-10-16.
_why: v4 names the seller but not the party that collects and shares the data, gives no revocation channel, and does not name the phone number's use as 'not a condition' with the collecting party. See docs/LEAD_CAPTURE_REQUIREMENTS.md.
text: By checking this box and clicking "{cta}", I agree that {brand}, operated by {legal_entity}, may share the information I entered on this form with {seller} (a licensed insurance agency), and that {seller} may contact me about {product_label} at the phone number and email I provided, including by calls and text messages that may use automated technology or prerecorded/artificial voice. My consent is not a condition of buying any product or service. Message and data rates may apply. I can revoke this consent at any time by replying STOP to a text or by emailing {contact_email}, and my request will be honored within 10 business days. I have read the Privacy Policy and Terms.
text_es: Al marcar esta casilla y hacer clic en "{cta}", acepto que {brand}, operado por {legal_entity}, comparta la información que escribí en este formulario con {seller} (una agencia de seguros con licencia), y que {seller} me contacte sobre {product_label} al número de teléfono y correo electrónico que proporcioné, incluso mediante llamadas y mensajes de texto que pueden usar tecnología automatizada o voz pregrabada/artificial. Mi consentimiento no es una condición para comprar ningún producto o servicio. Pueden aplicar tarifas de mensajes y datos. Puedo revocar este consentimiento en cualquier momento respondiendo STOP a un texto o escribiendo a {contact_email}, y mi solicitud se cumplirá en un plazo de 10 días hábiles. He leído la Política de Privacidad y los Términos.
what_changed_vs_v4: Names the collecting party ({brand}, operated by {legal_entity}) and says it shares the data with the named seller.
Adds a revocation channel (STOP and {contact_email}) and the 10-business-day commitment.
Says consent is not a condition of buying any product or service (v4 said 'any purchase').
Removes 'agree to Privacy Policy' as part of the same consent sentence; it is now 'I have read' (a link, not a consent).
questions_for_counsel: Is naming one seller per submission enough for FTSA/TCPA written consent when the lead is held (tier below the buyer's cutoff) and not delivered?
Should the result screen after submit avoid any plan names or prices (Fla. Stat. 626.112 solicitation risk)? Current design shows none.
Retention period for consents and form snapshots (current default: kept until deletion request; counsel to set).
Does a flat per-lead fee that is never tied to a sale fit Fla. Stat. 626.112 for this structure?
